label: Hopeful
tone: Forward-looking and warm: what gets better, and what the reader can do next.

label: Calm
tone: Even and unhurried: plain statements, no alarm, nothing to rush.

label: Curious
tone: Asks before it tells: open questions, a finding framed as worth looking into.

label: Reassuring
tone: Steadying: name the worry, then what the facts say about it.

label: Urgent
tone: Direct and time-aware: what matters now and why it cannot wait, without hype.

label: Playful
tone: Light and friendly: a wink in the wording, never at the facts' expense.
